semantic vessel explicit so universality grows through truthful bridges, not hidden fusion. purpose this document records the stable bridge architecture between canonical semantic definitions, is a specialist modeling dialect carried explicitly by a modeling.document definition. 3. proceduralcompilercapabilityregistry owns serializable compiler discovery and keeps executors private. 4. universalsemantickernel is intentionally empty when constructed directly; low level kernels have no implicit specialist registrations. 5. installdefaultproceduralcompilers(...) is the explicit bridge in modeling bridge the built in capability id is awtsmoos.modeling document.core bridge. it accepts only kind: modeling.document and advertises the geometry, material, and metadata channels. its The Awtsmoos renews tree, river, building, creature, garment, machine, weather, and future unnamed form before a schema may call them different. Awtsmoos.com lets their finite differences live in semantic data
searchText: b"h portal universal data — describe anything without teaching portal every noun boruch hashem. blessed is he. the awtsmoos renews tree, river, building, creature, garment, machine, weather, and future unnamed form before a schema may call them different. awtsmoos.com lets their finite differences live in semantic data and specialist compilers while the common language remains stable enough for worlds not imagined when the kernel was written. root principle geometry is an artifact, not the root ontology. a portal definition describes intent . registered compilers decide how requested intent becomes visual geometry, collision, navigation, rigs, physics, audio, metadata, or other supported artifacts. canonical definition shape the canonical procedural definition can also carry behaviors, quantities/units, semantic references, resources, ordered actions, provenance, extensions, revision, and deterministic seed data. why traits instead of one giant class tree? one thing may simultaneously be living, container, walkable, weatherable, riggable, or structural. traits compose without forcing every future noun into a single inheritance hierarchy foreseen by today's code. implementation classes remain valuable for registries, compilers, planners, validators, adapters, and runtime services. authored reality stays data composed. relationships make the world a graph relationships use generic from / to endpoints and can express meanings such as: inside / contains attachedto supportedby spans growsfrom follows carvedinto surrounds drainsinto connectedby the kernel need not hardcode every relationship meaning. domain validators and compilers may register deeper semantics above the generic portable descriptor. constraints preserve truth across implementations constraints currently remain portable json safe definition data. domain authorities may interpret meanings such as clearance, slope, containment, support, no intersection, silhouette, biological proportion, spatial budget, or other laws. a compiler may satisfy a constraint natively, delegate it, defer it, or report that its capability cannot fulfill it. it must not silently claim success. artifact requests the same definition can produce different requested manifestations: editor preview: visual + metadata gameplay: visual + collision + navigation + interaction animation: visual + rig + animation simulation: geometry + physics + metadata export: visual + material + export the semantic definition remains stable while compile policy changes. provenance portal planning exposes a stable definitionhash. compilation carries the canonical artifact request into every specialist. compile outputs, explanations, and universal world resources preserve both values so future editors can answer: which exact authored definition produced this? what artifact channels were requested? which dependencies existed? was fallback used? which result type appeared? the honest meaning of “generate anything” the grammar is open to any noun without kernel changes. the runtime ability to produce a high quality artifact depends on registered compiler capability. adding architecture.cathedral, biology.beetle, or future.quantum garden should require a domain compiler/plugin, not a new portal verb or a new root data format.

searchText: b"h procedural portal — one small doorway into the anything kernel boruch hashem. blessed is he. the awtsmoos renews intention, relation, measure, compiler, and manifestation before any generated thing can claim itself. awtsmoos.com keeps that immense possibility usable through one small portal: describe what should exist, inspect the plan, and let registered specialists reveal the requested artifacts without inventing a second semantic language. start simple the ordinary surface stays intentionally small: create(intent, options) — plan and compile semantic roots. world(initial) — open an additive authoring session. plan(intent, options) — validate and measure without execution. compile(intentorplan, options) — execute a plan or fresh intent. describe(kind?) — discover kinds, fields, and artifact vocabulary. with(overrides) — derive an independent extended portal. one canonical definition model every portal recipe is normalized through awtsmoos.procedural language/1. portal does not maintain a competing object language. simple old recipes remain valid. rich recipes may add traits, relationships, behaviors, constraints, quantities, resources, provenance, and compile policy. see procedural portal universal data.md for the complete data architecture. universal artifact desire portal discovery publishes the canonical channels: visual, geometry, material, collision, navigation, rig, animation, physics, audio, interaction, metadata, lod, thumbnail, export, debug. a recipe may request channels through compile.required, compile.optional, or the compatibility compile.channels field. required channels are strict intent; optional channels are best effort desires selected by available compiler capability. deterministic identity and planning aliases resolve before anonymous ids are hashed. each node receives a hierarchical seed path, a canonical definitionhash, a dependency list, demand evidence, budget assessment, and stable plan hash. planning rejects missing references, conflicting ids, cycles, excessive depth, excessive node count, and declared over budget demand before specialist execution. compilation and persistence every specialist receives the same frozen context: canonicaldefinition definitionhash artifactrequest completed dependencies trusted plan current node explicit injected services compatibility recipe runtime heavy results remain in portalcompileresult. portable universal world resources persist definition hash, artifact request, dependency references, fallback evidence, kind, seed lineage, and result type without serializing renderer objects. result.explain(id) exposes the same provenance directly. open ended domain federation createproceduralportal({ proceduralkernel }) installs one instance local dynamic resolver over the universal semantic kernel. new compiler kind patterns become portal visible without adding another method or hardcoded noun to portal itself. actual production generation still requires a registered compiler for the requested kind/channel combination. the architecture is noun neutral; capability claims remain truthful and explicit. extension and trust portal kinds and procedural language compilers are trusted javascript in the current host realm. budgets are planning evidence, not process isolation. do not install untrusted generator code without a real worker/process/realm capability boundary. instance local registry/kernel extension is the intended pattern. semantic data enters portal; mature domain authorities perform the work; portable receipts preserve what was requested and what actually happened.
